Camera is a slightly-high three-quarter macro so the dial, hands, indices and date window read crisply; the leather strap curves down and back, never free-standing. Warm 2900K morning light rakes from a window at left, modelling the polished case and brushed lugs. Quiet-luxury horology mood, lived-in and real.
